en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a tree-lined ravine or deep wooded lane with a road at the bottom and two narrow wooden pedestrian bridges crossing above it at different heights. A solitary person stands on the upper bridge. Dense green foliage surrounds the scene. At the bottom of the image there is red printed text in Cyrillic and Latin script indicating the place and subject.
